name: ENGL 3218
title: Ethnic Literature of United States
description: The literatures of ethnic American authors. Writers may include Natachee Scott Momaday, Maxine Hong Kingston, Zora Neale Hurston, Rolando Hinojosa, Bernard Malumud, Nicholasa Mohr, John Fante, among others. CA 4.
requirement_description: ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011; open to juniors or higher.
